reference_sql:
SELECT nxt.product_id, nxt.valid_from AS changed_on, old.list_price_eur AS old_price_eur, nxt.list_price_eur AS new_price_eur
FROM price_history old
JOIN price_history nxt ON nxt.product_id = old.product_id AND nxt.valid_from = old.valid_to + 1
WHERE nxt.valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
alternatives: SELECT old.product_id, nxt.valid_from AS changed_on, old.list_price_eur AS old_price_eur, nxt.list_price_eur AS new_price_eur FROM price_history nxt JOIN price_history old ON old.product_id = nxt.product_id AND old.valid_to = nxt.valid_from - 1 WHERE nxt.valid_from >= DATE '2025-03-01' AND nxt.valid_from < DATE '2025-04-01'

WITH next_start AS (SELECT a.product_id, a.valid_from, MIN(b.valid_from) AS next_from FROM price_history a JOIN price_history b ON b.product_id = a.product_id AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from GROUP BY a.product_id, a.valid_from) SELECT n.product_id, n.next_from AS changed_on, old.list_price_eur AS old_price_eur, nxt.list_price_eur AS new_price_eur FROM next_start n JOIN price_history old ON old.product_id = n.product_id AND old.valid_from = n.valid_from JOIN price_history nxt ON nxt.product_id = n.product_id AND nxt.valid_from = n.next_from WHERE n.next_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'

other_way.tradeoff: Finding the next start with MIN needs no date arithmetic and copes with gaps, but takes a CTE and two more joins.

solver.query:
SELECT n.product_id, n.valid_from AS changed_on, o.list_price_eur AS old_price_eur, n.list_price_eur AS new_price_eur
FROM price_history n
JOIN price_history o ON o.product_id = n.product_id AND o.valid_to + 1 = n.valid_from
WHERE n.valid_from >= DATE '2025-03-01' AND n.valid_from <= DATE '2025-03-31'
